commands.name: cache-warm
commands.description: Prompt cache band: show or hide it
commands.output: Prompt cache band hidden. /cache-warm shows it again.

commands.name: cache-warm-ping
commands.description: Prompt cache: keep it warm now (re-reads the cached conversation)

commands.name: cache-warm-auto
commands.description: Prompt cache: turn automatic keep-warm pings on or off
commands.output: Auto keep-warm on: while you are away the cache is re-read before it lapses, up to 4 times.

commands.name: cache-warm-collapse
commands.description: Prompt cache band: fold it to one line, or open it again

commands.name: cache-warm-status
commands.description: Prompt cache: every figure, the TTL and the keep-warm settings
commands.output:
State: warm, 60m left
TTL: 1h (assumed until a reply says)
Last write or read: 2025-10-09T08:53:20.040Z
Prefix the next message re-sends: 99k tokens
Session: 93% hit, 91k read, 4.3k written, 2.1k uncached
Input cost against no cache: −80%
Lapses between replies: 0
Keep-warm: auto, 0 pings (0 re-read), 0/4 automatic since your last message; auto pings 3m 00s before the cache lapses
Notifications when cooling: off

./register.tsx hooks on classic.SessionStart, classic.Stop, classic.PostModelSwitch, session.compact do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them

./register.tsx calls: $.clock.every, $.clock.now, $.command.register, $.fs.read (via learnTtl), $.fs.stat (via learnTtl), $.model.fork (via ping), $.state.get, $.state.set, $.store.get, $.store.set (via setTtl, toggleAuto, toggleCollapsed, toggleOpen), $.ui.notify (via tick), $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast (via actionsFor, tick)
